name: Bras Basah
summary: Arts-and-school belt between City Hall and Dhoby Ghaut — museums, campuses, and condo edges with walkable culture and interchange optionality.
body: Bras Basah is the shortlist when arts campuses, museum weekends, and dual-line adjacency matter more than mall-spine living. The belt sits between City Hall civic core and Dhoby Ghaut interchange gravity; housing is mostly condo and serviced edges rather than HDB grids. Expats land here for walkable culture nights and car-light CBD hops. Watch-outs: student/tourist footfall, event noise, and building-by-building visitor / refuse SOPs. Compare with City Hall for Padang-adjacent polish, Bugis for denser retail, and Mattar when you want quieter mid-town evenings.
